summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder never received the goods and that the address on the order is not theirs, so they did not authorise delivery to it.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires proof the goods were delivered, on or before the chargeback date, to an address that materially matches the address the cardholder gave at purchase.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: The DPDx screenshot gives a tracking number, carrier and a DELIVERED status on 10 April 2025 for a parcel sent by LumaTech, but the parcel was left in a safe place with no signature or proof of delivery photo, and it was delivered to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf (M1 7DR) which is not the cardholder's billing address (M14 5RT, AVS N).
requirements.gap: No signature, no delivery photo or geotag, and no evidence tying the delivery address to the cardholder; recipient is shown only as 'Lumatech Customer'.

citations.quote:
Status: DELIVERED
Delivered: 10 April 2025, 15:22
Left in safe place: 'front porch'

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: This is a physical goods sale by an electronics retailer (MCC 5732) for headphones and an iPad shipped by DPDx, so no service was rendered and the service evidence requirement cannot apply.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: The carrier record shows delivery on 10 April 2025, the day after the 9 April 2025 transaction and well before the 2 May 2025 chargeback date.

requirements.title: Delivery address matches
requirements.text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.finding: The delivery address on the tracking page matches the shipping address on order LT-200931 exactly, but that address is a merchant generated record asserting the customer entered it, AVS returned N against the cardholder's billing postcode M14 5RT, and the cardholder denies the address is theirs.
requirements.gap: Nothing independently links the cardholder to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf: no prior undisputed deliveries there, no account history, no device or IP evidence tying the order entry to the cardholder.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the delivery address is not theirs and AVS returned N against billing postcode M14 5RT while the parcel went to M1 7DR; the merchant's only answer is its own order note that the customer entered the address, which the analyst should test against account, device or prior delivery history.

justification: R4 is only partial because nothing independent links the cardholder to the M1 7DR delivery address, and R1 lacks signature or photo proof; both gaps are plausibly fixable by the merchant.
rationale:
The issuer alleges non receipt and says the M1 7DR delivery address is not the cardholder's and was not authorised.
DPDx tracking 15441288821100 shows the GBP642 order LT-200931 delivered on 10 April 2025, before the 2 May 2025 chargeback, so R3 is met.
Delivery was left in a safe place with no signature or photo, and the recipient is named only as 'Lumatech Customer', weakening R1.
AVS returned N and the shipping postcode M1 7DR differs from the billing postcode M14 5RT, so the address match under R4 rests solely on the merchant's own order record.
Represent only once the merchant supplies carrier proof of delivery detail and independent evidence linking the cardholder to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf.
merchant_requests: Obtain from DPDx the full proof of delivery record for tracking 15441288821100, including any safe place photo, GPS coordinates and the carrier's recorded recipient name.
Provide the customer account history for a.carter****@gmail.com showing any earlier, undisputed orders delivered to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR.
Provide checkout and login logs for order LT-200931 on 9 April 2025 showing the IP 188.29.44.179 and device fp_c01e84f2b9 used on previous undisputed orders by the same cardholder.
Provide the 3DS authentication response detail for txn_9931CD showing why the status was only 'attempted'.
Provide any post delivery contact from the customer, such as emails, returns requests or support tickets referencing order LT-200931.
